info.title: Endurance API
info.description: Calculations for running, cycling, swimming, and triathlon.
info.x-guidance:
Use this API as a calculation toolbox for endurance sports.

Discovery and invocation guidance:
- Treat `/openapi.json` as the canonical discovery contract.
- Free reference routes are intentionally open and declared with `security: []`.
- Paid calculators challenge with HTTP 402 and `WWW-Authenticate` before body/query validation runs.
- Prefer JSON request bodies when an operation exposes one.
- For query-style helper endpoints, use the documented query parameters; the OpenAPI spec mirrors those inputs in a JSON schema for discovery.
- The API is organized by sport and calculation type: running, cycling, swimming, triathlon, and general pacing/conditioning utilities.
- Endpoints return deterministic math or table lookups, so they are safe to call repeatedly with the same inputs.

post.description:
Calculate age-graded performance using WMA 2023 factors.

Age grade % = (open_standard / actual_time) * age_factor * 100

Returns the percentage and the equivalent open-class time.

get.description: Return WMA age-grade factors for a distance.

post.description:
Calculate VDOT from a race time using Jack Daniels' formula.

VDOT = (VO2max * 100) / (percent_max * oxygen_cost)
Simplified: VDOT ≈ (velocity_mps * 60 * 1000) / (3.5 + distance_factor)

get.summary: Get training paces for a VDOT
get.description: Return training paces (sec/km) for a given VDOT.

get.summary: Predict race times for a VDOT
get.description: Predict race times for common distances at a given VDOT.

post.description:
Determine cycling category from FTP w/kg.

Systems:
- usac: USA Cycling categories (sex-specific)
- zwift: Zwift racing categories (A-D)
- zwift-ce: Zwift Category Enforcement (A+ through E)

get.summary: Get category thresholds for a system
get.description: Return all category thresholds for a system.

post.summary: Calculate FINA points from swim time
post.description:
Calculate FINA points using the cubic formula:

Points = 1000 * (base_time / time)^3

Base times are the 2024 FINA 1000-point standards.

get.description: Return all base times for a sex.

post.summary: Calculate CP and W' from max efforts
post.description:
Calculate Critical Power (CP) and W' using linear regression:

Work = CP * time + W'
power * time = CP * time + W'
power = CP + W' / time

Uses 2+ maximal efforts of different durations (typically 2-20 min).

get.summary: Predict power for a duration given CP/W'
get.description: Predict sustainable power for a given duration.

post.summary: Predict race time using Riegel formula
post.description:
Riegel formula: T2 = T1 * (D2/D1)^exponent

Default exponent 1.06 works well for running. 
Cycling ~1.05, Swimming ~1.10.

get.summary: Predict common race distances from one time
get.description: Predict 5k, 10k, half, marathon from any known distance.

post.description:
Calculate Purdy points by linear interpolation in the table.

Purdy points are an older running scoring system, similar to age grading
but without age/sex adjustment.

TSS = (duration_hr * NP * IF) / (FTP * 3600) * 100
where IF = NP / FTP

Simplifies to: TSS = duration_hr * IF^2 * 100

TRIMP (Training Impulse) - Banister's method:

TRIMP = duration_min * HRR_fraction * exp(1.92 * HRR_fraction) for men
TRIMP = duration_min * HRR_fraction * exp(1.67 * HRR_fraction) for women

where HRR_fraction = (avg_hr - resting_hr) / (max_hr - resting_hr)

Calculate heart rate zones for various systems.

Systems:
- coggan: Andy Coggan 7-zone (default)
- british: British Cycling 6-zone
- garmin: Garmin 5-zone
- karvonen: Karvonen (%HRR) - requires resting_hr

Convert between pace and speed units.

Supported units:
- min_per_km: minutes per kilometer (running)
- min_per_mi: minutes per mile (running)
- kmh: kilometers per hour (cycling)
- mph: miles per hour (cycling)
- sec_per_100m: seconds per 100m (swimming)
- sec_per_100y: seconds per 100 yards (swimming SCY)

get.summary: Convert swim paces between pool types
get.description:
Convert swim pace between pool types.

SCM = short course meters (25m)
LCM = long course meters (50m)
SCY = short course yards (25y)

Uses standard conversion factors.

post.description:
Apply altitude derating.

Based on published physiology data:
- VO2max: ~4.5%/1000m above 1500m
- Power (cycling): ~3.5%/1000m above 1500m  
- Running pace: ~1.5%/1000m (slower)

get.description:
Estimate days to acclimate to altitude.

Rough guideline: 11-14 days per 1000m for full acclimation.

post.description:
Adjust pace/power for heat using WBGT approximation.

WBGT ≈ 0.7 * Twb + 0.2 * Tglobe + 0.1 * Tair
Simplified: WBGT ≈ Tair * (0.5 + 0.5 * humidity/100) for still air

Derating (ACSMM/IOC guidelines):
- WBGT < 10°C: minimal impact
- WBGT 10-18°C: ~1-3% pace slowdown
- WBGT 18-28°C: ~3-7% slowdown
- WBGT > 28°C: high risk, >10% slowdown

Critical Swim Speed (CSS) from two time trials:

CSS (m/s) = (400 - 200) / (time_400 - time_200)
CSS per 100m = 100 / CSS_mps

Threshold pace ≈ CSS + 1-2 sec/100m

get.summary: Get swim training zones from CSS
get.description: Return swim training zones based on CSS.

post.description:
Calculate bike fit measurements from body dimensions.

Based on common fit systems (Lemond, Greg LeMond, BikeFit, etc.)
These are starting points - professional fit recommended.
